sections.name: About Us
sections.copy: Distinct Pharma Pay Hub Nigeria is a pioneering fintech company specializing in embedded finance solutions for the pharmaceutical and healthcare sector. Founded by an experienced Embedded Finance Architect, we understand the unique financial challenges faced by pharmacies, drug distributors, and healthcare providers across Nigeria. Our mission is to bridge the gap between traditional pharmaceutical commerce and modern digital banking, providing tailored payment infrastructure that ensures security, compliance, and operational efficiency. Based in Owerri, Imo State, we serve businesses throughout Nigeria with cutting-edge technology that simplifies transactions, improves cash flow management, and enhances customer experience. We combine deep industry expertise with innovative financial technology to deliver solutions that truly understand the pharmaceutical business landscape.

sections.name: Our Solutions
sections.copy: Digital Payment Gateway: Accept all payment methods including cards, bank transfers, USSD, and mobile money with industry-leading security and instant settlement. Pharmacy Management Integration: Seamlessly connect your inventory and sales systems with our payment infrastructure for automated reconciliation and real-time financial visibility. Embedded Lending Solutions: Provide your customers with flexible payment options through integrated buy-now-pay-later and credit facilities designed for pharmaceutical purchases. Multi-Channel Payment Processing: Enable payments across physical stores, online platforms, mobile apps, and delivery services from a single unified system. Compliance & Reporting: Automated regulatory compliance tools, comprehensive transaction reports, and audit-ready documentation tailored for pharmaceutical businesses. Virtual Accounts & Collections: Issue dedicated account numbers to customers and suppliers for seamless business-to-business transactions and improved cash flow management. Point-of-Sale Solutions: Advanced POS terminals with pharmacy-specific features, inventory tracking, and customer management capabilities.

sections.name: Frequently Asked Questions
sections.copy: What types of businesses can use Distinct Pharma Pay Hub? We serve community pharmacies, hospital pharmacies, pharmaceutical distributors, medical supply stores, and healthcare facilities of all sizes across Nigeria. How long does setup take? Most businesses are fully operational within 48-72 hours. Complex integrations with multiple locations may take up to one week, with our technical team managing the entire process. What are your transaction fees? Our pricing is transparent and competitive, typically ranging from 0.5% to 1.5% depending on transaction volume and payment method. We provide custom quotes based on your specific business needs with no hidden charges. Is my customer data secure? Absolutely. We employ bank-level 256-bit encryption, are PCI-DSS compliant, and follow all Central Bank of Nigeria data protection guidelines. Your customer information is never shared with third parties. Can I integrate with my existing pharmacy software? Yes. We have pre-built integrations with major pharmacy management systems used in Nigeria and can develop custom integrations for specialized software. What payment methods do you support? We support all major payment methods: Verve, Mastercard, Visa cards; bank transfers; USSD codes; mobile money (including Paga, OPay); QR codes; and cash collection with digital receipts. Do you provide hardware like POS terminals? Yes. We supply modern POS terminals optimized for pharmacy operations, including receipt printers and barcode scanners. Hardware costs are separate from transaction fees. What kind of support do you offer? We provide 24/7 technical support via phone, WhatsApp, and email. Our Owerri-based team offers support in English, Igbo, Yoruba, and Pidgin. We also provide on-site assistance for businesses in the South-East region.
